card_fields_only_on_credit.name: card_fields_only_on_credit
card_fields_only_on_credit.value:
"account"."kind" = 'credit'
    OR ("account"."credit_limit" IS NULL AND "account"."statement_day" IS NULL AND "account"."due_day" IS NULL)

has_an_identity.name: has_an_identity
has_an_identity.value: "app_user"."email" IS NOT NULL OR "app_user"."phone" IS NOT NULL

password_needs_an_address.name: password_needs_an_address
password_needs_an_address.value: "app_user"."password_hash" IS NULL OR "app_user"."email" IS NOT NULL

has_a_rule.name: has_a_rule
has_a_rule.value: "schedule"."rrule" IS NOT NULL OR "schedule"."hijri_rule" IS NOT NULL
